palette.notes: Code: 25 colours on the still, one ramp with 33.5 deg hue shift. Compilation of others' scenes: deep blue nights with warm windows/fires, one sunset, one red-orange city.

lighting: Mostly night scenes: cool blue ambient with small warm sources (street lamp, lantern, house windows, campfire); one dawn mountain scene with peach light.
silhouette: Few characters; tiny dark figures (a man with a lantern and a dog, a girl on a car, pirates on a ship) read as black silhouettes against lighter skies.

motion.timing: Code: median hold 100 ms (3s), 3.75 changes/s. Each scene stays about 1.7 to 3.3 s on the sheet (some appear in two consecutive samples) before a hard cut.

texture: Clean landscape pixel scenes with light dithering (share 0.001); stars, snow and waves give the only motion.
camera: Static 4:3 frames, one per scene; hard cuts on the music, no pans.
sound: Lo-fi music (caption credits a Shiloh Dynasty track); cuts follow the song.

acting.enters: Characters are already placed in each scene; no entrances.
acting.acts: Small still figures doing quiet things: walking a dog, sitting under stars, sailing.
acting.depth: Characters stay small in the foreground or mid-ground under huge skies; scale sells loneliness and calm.

techniques: cool night ambient + one small warm light source
tiny silhouette figure against a large sky
scene montage cut to music, about 2 s per scene
ambient particle loops: falling snow, stars, waves
feel: deep blue nights + one warm light + tiny silhouette + 2 s cuts on lo-fi = serene nostalgic mood (not original art; compilation)
for_fred: Use a 'tiny Fred' shot: a wide night scene with Fred small in the corner holding one warm light, held 2 s between busier beats. It gives the reel a breath instead of another big animation.
